content:
elena: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the cloud-provider + model-registry + auth outage. Consolidating action items into one tracker. Short list below — owners pls ack and paste ETA. Link to doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-514 (internal)

samir: I can own auth fallback hardening. Plan: implement client-side multi-auth fallback, add circuit breaker + metrics. ETA: 2 weeks (2026-04-06). @maria can you help with integration tests?

maria: ack. I'll do test harness and e2e scenarios. Blockers: need service account with impersonation — @kevin to approve.

kevin: approved service account. added to infra-requests queue. ETA for creds: tomorrow.

elena: Action table (quick):
```
1) Auth fallback hardening — owner: samir — ETA: 2026-04-06 — deps: creds, e2e tests
2) Model-registry token rotation guardrails — owner: priyanka — ETA: 2026-03-30 — deps: vendor API contract
3) Cross-cloud failover runbook & drill — owner: kevin + oncall-sre — ETA: 2026-04-15 — deps: runbook doc, playbooks
4) SLA & vendor escalation playbook — owner: elena — ETA: 2026-03-28 — deps: legal confirmation
```
Please don't edit the doc directly; comment for changes.

priyanka: I'll own token rotation guardrails. Suggestion: add a soft-cache layer in model-registry side to tolerate short auth blips. ETA end of next week (2026-03-30). I'll post a design doc by Tue.

oncall-sre: For the runbook/drill, recommend we add an automated smoke test that hits alternate region. I can help wire alerts for RTO > 30s. Will open a runbook PR.

devops-bot: Incident postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1761112222 — checklist created, assigning tasks.

elena: Recurring pattern note: we've seen auth-token TTL storms with third-party provider ~monthly spikes. We need a medium-term mitigation: vendor-contract SLA change + local short-term caching. Put this on vendor management backlog.

samir: quick question — for "soft-cache" do we mean prefix KV cache or token caching? I think token cache with jittered refresh is safest.

priyanka: token cache. We'll implement jittered refresh + negative caching. I'll include details in design doc.

maria: Also adding regression tests: simulate vendor rate limit + bad 500 responses. Will add to nightly-e2e.

kevin: Suggest quarterly vendor failover drills — ops + vendor on call. Will sync with partnerships.

elena: Next steps: owners to post 1-line status updates in this thread every 3 business days until closed. I'll run weekly rollups into the postmortem ticket. If owners need additional headcount, escalate in #eng-sre-prioritization.

samir: ack. First status update posted here 2026-03-25.

priyanka: ack. design doc link (draft): https://redwood.docs/designs/token-rotation-guard.pdf

maria: creds received, starting test harness today.

kevin: scheduled first vendor drill for 2026-04-09, invite sent.

elena: thanks all. closing in 1 week unless new blockers appear. :thumbsup:
